description:
Route handlers hand-parse and clamp (Math.max(0, body.weight ?? 0)), so a malformed body becomes a silently coerced row rather than a 400. The clamping is deliberate and mostly correct, but it means the API cannot tell a caller it sent nonsense.

Start with LogSetBody, UpdateSetBody and StartSessionBody. @afya/shared stays the source of truth for the types; the schemas validate against it rather than replacing it. Sequenced after back-dating so performedAt is schema'd once.
title: Validate request bodies with Zod at the HTTP boundary
